name: Apple Inc.
hook: The garage startup that became the world's most valuable company — Jobs, Wozniak and the products.

facts.label: April 1, 1976
facts.statement: Steve Jobs, Steve Wozniak and Ronald Wayne founded Apple on April 1, 1976; Wayne sold his stake days later for $800.

facts.label: Steve Jobs
facts.statement: Steve Jobs died in 2011; in his 2005 Stanford speech he warned, "Your time is limited, so don't waste it."

facts.label: Steve Wozniak
facts.statement: Steve Wozniak built the Apple II in 1977, the first affordable home PC, and holds the patent for its video-display microcomputer.

facts.label: the Apple logo
facts.statement: The first Apple logo, from 1976, showed Isaac Newton under a tree; the bite in today's apple nods to Adam and Eve's tree of knowledge.

facts.label: Macintosh
facts.statement: The Macintosh, introduced in 1984, was named by adding an "A" to the McIntosh apple.

facts.label: Tim Cook
facts.statement: Tim Cook succeeded Steve Jobs as Apple's CEO in 2011.

facts.label: Pixar
facts.statement: Jobs bought Pixar for $5 million in 1986 and sold it to Disney in 2006 for $7.4 billion.
